correctness.rationale: Cyclic Dirichlet spacings give q_h=(1-hr)_+^(n-1), and component counting is an exact cyclic long-gap run pattern except the connected X=0 correction. Inclusion-exclusion yields the finite-sample covariance identity. Fixed-order expansion of q_h at radius t/n, with Chebyshev bound P(X=0)=O(1/n), proves the stated limit. Strict positivity of e^t-1-t^2 ensures the only positive root for j>=2 is log((j+1)/2); j=1 is everywhere positive. Directly checked all 12124 standalone assertions; finite tests are corroborative.

The complete all-fixed-size logarithmic sequence of genuine sign reversals, the isolated-vertex exception, and the exact radius-independent regression conditional on long-gap count describe a nontrivial dependence mechanism not implied by univariate expectations or generic Gaussian convergence; no arbitrary finite slicing or tiny constant sharpening is required.
